blocks.caption: Proteins ke hayatiyati kaam
rows: Hormonal proteins
nashonuma, tarakki, metabolism aur tolid ko qabu ya munazzam karte
insulin, jo pancreas banata hai, glucose ko khoon se cells mein jane ko munazzam karta
Storage proteins
ugte paudon ya jaanwaron ki ibtidai nashonuma ke liye ghizaiyat jama karte
ferritin loha jama karta (kuch bacteria aur paudon aur jaanwaron ke tissues mein)
Structural proteins
reerh ki haddi wale jaandaron mein sab se zyada; fibrous; shakal aur sahara
baalon mein keratin, khoon ke lothron mein fibrin, jild, ligaments, tendons aur haddiyon mein collagen
Contractile proteins
muscle ke patle aur mote dhaage; sikurna aur phailna
actin aur myosin
Defensive proteins
infection se larte aur zakhm se bachate
antibodies khaas antigens (jaraseem par proteins) se jur kar unhein khatam karti hain
Transport (carrier) proteins
molecules aur ions ko jism mein aur jhilliyon ke aar paar le jate
haemoglobin: phephron aur tissues ke darmiyan khoon ke safar mein oxygen is ke lohe se jurti
Receptor proteins
cell ki jhilli mein; kimiyai signals lete aur jawab aage dete
jhilli ke receptors
Regulatory proteins
cell aur jism ki sargarmiyan qabu karte
insulin (shakar ka metabolism) aur growth hormone

blocks.prompt: Baal, nakhun, seeng aur paron ka keratin mazboot, lachakdar aur aasani se denature na hone wala hai. Kya yeh zyada tar hydrogen bonds ki wajah se hai ya disulphide bonds?
blocks.explanation: Disulphide bonds: yeh zanjeeron ke darmiyan covalent S-S jor hain, hydrogen bonds se kaheen mazboot, is liye garmi aur halke chemicals unhein aasani se nahi tor'te.

blocks.prompt: Aik jaisi qism aur tadaad ke amino acids wale do peptides primary structure mein kaise mukhtalif ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Amino acids mukhtalif tarteeb mein jur sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Hamare jism mein do sab se aam secondary structures kaun se hain?
Denature hua protein theek kaam kyun nahi karta?
blocks.explanation: Denaturation secondary aur tertiary structure ko thaamne wale bonds tor deti hai, is liye protein apni khaas 3D shakal (enzyme ke liye us ki active site ki shakal) kho deta hai, aur us ka kaam isi shakal par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt: Garam karne par anday ki safedi kyun jam jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Garmi globular albumin ki zanjeeron ko mudi rakhne wale hydrogen bonds torti hai; zanjeerein khul kar ulajhti aur aapas mein jurti hain, aur na ghulne wala thos banta hai (denaturation).

items: Proteins hormones (insulin), zakheere (ferritin), dhaancha (keratin, collagen), muscle (actin, myosin), difa (antibodies), naql-o-hamal (haemoglobin), receptors aur regulators ka kaam karte.
